# Aim
The aim here is to plot the CBS cell lines PB and SB sorted files as a FACS plot with the corresponding gates. 
We have different replicates for the different cell lines. Therefore we have to choose a representative replicate. I decided to use E2171/E2226 that contains CBS16, 16A, CRE6 and 3xCTCF cell lines. 

Saved the xml experiment. 


#load FACSDiva file
```{r}
library(openCyto) 
library(CytoML)
library(flowWorkspace)

diva_xml_file = "/DATA/projects/CTCF_Sox2/FACS_files/export_fcs_R_E2171_E2226_xml/Mathias (BvS) 20230207_E2171_E2096.xml"

diva_ws <- open_diva_xml(diva_xml_file)
  

gs <- diva_to_gatingset(diva_ws,
                        name = 1, #the group to import
                        path = "/DATA/projects/CTCF_Sox2/FACS_files/export_fcs_R_E2171_E2226_xml/fcs_files",
                        swap_cols = F, #apparently we don't need to swap the FSC/SSC-H/W here (this is a known diva 'bug', if you import the xml into flowjo the columns are swapped but apparently not here) 
                        worksheet = "global",
                        verbose = F,
                        execute = T)

pdata_tib = pData(gs) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(name_short = str_remove(str_remove(name, fixed("Mathias (BvS) ME20230207_E2171_E2096_")),"_([0-9]){3}\\.fcs"),
         cell_line = case_when(grepl("neg_ctrl", name) ~ "ctrl",
                               grepl("CBS16", name) ~ "CBS16",
                               grepl("_16A_", name) ~ "16A",
                               grepl("_CRE6_", name) ~ "CRE6",
                               grepl("_3xCT", name) ~ "CBS3x",
                               .default = "other"),
         treatment = case_when(grepl("PB", name_short) ~ "PB",
                               grepl("SB", name_short) ~ "SB",
                               grepl("UT", name_short) ~ "UT",
                               .default = "other"),
         recording = case_when(grepl("_sort", name_short) ~ "sorting",
                               .default = "pre-recording")
         )
       
pdata_df = as.data.frame(pdata_tib)
rownames(pdata_df) = pdata_df$name

pData(gs) = pdata_df
```


ggcyto works very well for plotting (with the axis_x/y_inverse_trans we get the actual fluorescent values ont he axes again.)

```{r, plot_prerecorded_only, height = 14, width = 7}
gs_oi = subset(gs, cell_line != "ctrl" & treatment != "untreated" & recording == "pre-recording") 
#plot the data from the recording, not the sorting, so we have a similar number of cells for PB and SB (SB we recorded many more during the sorting)

#Check wchich gates
gate_paths <- gs_get_pop_paths(gs)
    print(gate_paths)


ggcyto::ggcyto(gs_oi, aes(x = "GFP", y = "mCherry"), subset = "P4") +
  #facet by cell line / treatment
  facet_grid(cell_line ~ treatment) +
  
  #plot cells
  geom_hex(bins = 126, aes( fill = after_stat(ncount))) +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = 'Spectral') + #manually adding a fill scale also forces the scale to be linear again.
  
  #plot_gates
  ggcyto::geom_gate(c("effect sort","high_sort", "mCh-neg_GFP-pos"), col = 'black') +
  ggcyto::geom_stats(adjust = c(-0.3, 0.5), digits = 3, size = 3) +
    
  #layout
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio = 1) +
  ggtitle(element_blank())+
  ggcyto::axis_x_inverse_trans() +
  ggcyto::axis_y_inverse_trans() +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2)))+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.1)) +
  ggcyto::labs_cyto(labels = "marker")

```

## Plot PB and SB 3xCTCF sample
```{r}
gs_CBS3x = subset(gs, cell_line %in% c("CBS3x", "CRE6") & treatment %in% c("PB", "SB") & recording == "pre-recording")

ggcyto::ggcyto(gs_CBS3x, aes(x = "GFP", y = "mCherry"), subset = "P4") +
  #facet by cell line / treatment
  facet_grid(treatment ~ cell_line) +
  
  #plot cells
  geom_hex(bins = 126, aes( fill = after_stat(ncount))) +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = 'Spectral') + #manually adding a fill scale also forces the scale to be linear again.
  
  #plot_gates
  ggcyto::geom_gate(c("effect sort","high_sort", "mCh-neg_GFP-pos"), col = 'black') +
  ggcyto::geom_stats(adjust = c(-0.3, 0.5), digits = 3, size = 3) +
    
  #layout
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio = 1) +
  ggtitle(element_blank())+
  ggcyto::axis_x_inverse_trans() +
  ggcyto::axis_y_inverse_trans() +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2)))+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.1)) +
  ggcyto::labs_cyto(labels = "marker")
```
